blockers.detail: DG-0008 is not registered: absent from STUDIES.jsonl and no studies/DG-0008/PLAN.md.
No committed authorizations/DG-0008.yaml and no human price/spend/lifetime envelope; unknown price or lifetime fails closed.
Raw corpus farm destroyed, IEMOCAP licence-gated and in-tree source locations unrecorded; lawful restoration and byte-identical example/split identity evidence are absent.
No committed studies/DG-0008/compute/{plan.json,inputs.json}; the DG-0001 S envelope is sanity-only.
generate_opportunity_manifest.py, the manifest-driven sampler, the default-off auxiliary-loss hook, the fixed-LR diagnostic mode and pinned-equality checks are not implemented.
No frozen canonical embedding SHA-256 set or identity digest exists, so dual identity admission cannot be evaluated.
Five-epoch runtime for each arm class is unmeasured; total GPU-hours and cost remain null.
The selected compatible GPU offer, its current hourly rate and the maximum paid lifetime are unknown.
Stage 1 cannot run until the corpus, dual identity, compute plan, implementation and human authorization all exist.

The resolved embedded infra control plane (monorepo infra/, v0.1.0, commit 6a2e2bd) exposes only `doctor`, `config` and `worker`; the `volume`, `storage` and `job` verbs that improvements.compute drives (volume list/show/cache stats; storage list/verify/read/download; job list/status/logs/submit/cancel) are absent, so no job spec can be submitted.

The infra tree is DIRTY: six tracked infra files are modified (AGENTS.md, README.md, controller/cloud-init.yaml, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/OPERATIONS.md, docs/SPEC.md), so no clean committed infra version can be identified as the one that would operate the Study.

change_requests.reason: Each dg0008.opportunity-manifest.v2 object embeds step_keys of exactly S x 2048 entries, and 500 (cell, fold, seed, epoch) objects exist; holding the whole matrix resident is avoidable. Streaming each per-epoch canonical object to its SHA-256 and to the frozen output preserves the clause-5/11 J byte identity, the clause-12 tuple-to-digest association and every per-epoch, run-level and matrix digest, so the streamed path bounds peak memory without touching any scientific invariant.

estimated_cost.basis: GPU rate, total runtime, storage lifetime and idle/teardown are all unmeasured; unknown price or lifetime fails closed under .agents/policies/autonomy.md.

estimated_runtime.basis: Five-epoch training-plus-validation duration for each of the four arm classes and the repeat is unmeasured; the 201-job total is unknown until a compatible-GPU benchmark measures or safely bounds one run.

expected_bottlenecks: opportunity-manifest construction: 500 per-epoch objects each carry all S x 2048 step keys; MATERIALIZE holds the whole matrix resident, which STREAM_CANONICAL_BYTES avoids without changing canonical bytes or digests
no compatible-GPU five-epoch benchmark exists, so runtime and cost stay null and cannot be bounded
unknown provider hourly price and unknown maximum paid lifetime leave spend unbounded
the resolved embedded infra exposes only doctor/config/worker, so job submission, storage reads and volume attachment are unavailable
one live job workspace with at most two concurrent matrix jobs serialises the 201 trainings
~200 GB corpus volume must be attached at pod creation in its own data centre and the container disk must be at least 100 GB
GPU utilisation, CPU/RAM utilisation, disk I/O and network throughput are not exposed, so utilisation bottlenecks cannot be observed

policy.reason: No committed improvements/taskrelation/research/authorizations/DG-0008.yaml (envelope-check --scope DG-0008 --action submit-job exits 3 AuthorizationError); the budget is undeclared and unknown, so new spend fails closed.

recommended_action: Executor revision: set IF-MANIFEST-IO to STREAM_CANONICAL_BYTES, emitting and freezing every per-epoch object and digest exactly as before. This clears only the construction-flexible request; execution stays blocked independently because DG-0008 is unregistered with no authorization, the raw corpus and dual-identity evidence are absent, no compute plan exists, no compatible-GPU benchmark bounds runtime/cost, and the resolved embedded infra (commit 6a2e2bd, v0.1.0, DIRTY tree) lacks the job/storage/volume surface, so no preflight can ACCEPT.
